Designing a combinational circuit means writing the function in [[Boolean Algebra]] and then
making the expression as small as possible, because every term is gates you have to pay for.
[[Karnaugh Maps]] in [[THE NEW TURING OMNIBUS]] is the method for doing that by hand.
